recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，碎片狀組織大多被密集深藍的小圓形細胞佔據，下方中央有一塊淡粉紅、細胞核淡化的區域，上方可見一小段骨小樑，呈現白血病浸潤合併局部壞死的低倍樣貌。
features: Fragmented, markedly hypercellular marrow tissue at low power
Diffuse sheets of small to intermediate hyperchromatic round cells
Focal pale eosinophilic area with faded nuclei and ghost cell outlines (lower center)
Bone trabecula fragment at the top of the field
Absence of recognizable fat and normal hematopoietic islands
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows fragmented, hypercellular marrow with a fragment of bony trabecula. The intertrabecular space is replaced by sheets of small to intermediate cells with dark round nuclei. A focal pale eosinophilic area with faded nuclear staining and ghost-like cellular outlines is present, consistent with coagulative necrosis. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with focal bone marrow necrosis; higher-power examination and immunohistochemistry are needed to characterize the infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Would show cohesive nests or desmoplastic stroma and be positive for non-hematopoietic markers rather than a discohesive sheet of blasts.
Mature lymphoma infiltrates are often paratrabecular or nodular with admixed residual hematopoiesis and lack TdT/CD34 blast markers.
Viable marrow at the edge would show normal trilineage hematopoiesis rather than a monotonous blast population.
